public.text: Treating the LHR as foundational may be unrealistic where facilities still depend on paper records, basic registers, or poorly connected programme systems. The document does not define a minimum viable LHR scope.
public.suggestedRevision: Define progressive LHR maturity levels, beginning with priority summaries or datasets, selected facilities and programmes, and document exchange before advancing to comprehensive structured longitudinal information.
